reading: Negative-to-neutral kinetic-only packet. Stable, but did not lift the style ceiling.
Slightly stronger content-preserving kinetic packet. Better than K_spatial, but still not a style-ceiling solution by itself.
Strong style-ceiling packet. Reaches near-target style, but content damage remains catastrophic.
Snapshot-matched repaired x-pred packet. Clearly stronger than XPred_Barycenter on both style and LPIPS, but still far from the LPIPS target band.
Snapshot-matched proximal-only repair attempt. Clean negative result: weaker than XPred_Barycenter and much weaker than XPred_Kmanifold on both style and LPIPS.
Snapshot-matched combo repair attempt. Strong negative result: adding the current high-pass residual branch on top of K_manifold degrades both style and LPIPS.
Snapshot-matched modulation repair attempt. Clear improvement over both high-pass residual packets, but still worse than XPred_Kmanifold on both style and LPIPS.

Snapshot-matched cross-attention proximal repair plus longer training. Keeps style essentially flat while improving LPIPS beyond the 8-epoch frontier, but the LPIPS gap to the long-range target is still large.
Snapshot-matched anisotropic transport repair on top of the Pattn frontier. Lower-LPIPS early tradeoff, but not a promoted frontier because style drops too far and later epochs degrade.
